Container.Name: RunningWithRifles
Container.Overview: Running With Rifles dedicated server for Unraid. Uses SteamCMD to install/update AppID 270150, automatically starts the vanilla invasion mode, and keeps server data persistent. A direct cache-pool path is required because RWR's older resource loader is incompatible with the /mnt/user FUSE path.

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: Persistent RWR data. Use the direct pool path (/mnt/cache or /mnt/your-pool), not /mnt/user, because the RWR resource loader fails through Unraid FUSE.

Config.Name: Steam Username
Config.Description: Steam account username. Required for first install, updates, and validation. Use a dedicated account that owns RWR.

Config.Name: Steam Password
Config.Description: Steam account password. Required only when SteamCMD must install, update, or validate RWR.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Set true to update RWR through SteamCMD before starting.

Config.Name: Validate On Start
Config.Description: Set true to run SteamCMD app validation before every server start. Useful for repairing damaged files but slower than a normal start.

Config.Name: SteamCMD Retries
Config.Description: Advanced: number of retries after transient Steam network failures, from 0 through 5. Authentication and Steam Guard failures are not retried.

Config.Name: Automatic Game Start
Config.Description: Automatically start the selected RWR script after the game console is ready.

Config.Name: Game Mode Script
Config.Description: RWR AngelScript startup file. The supported vanilla dedicated-server default is start_invasion.as.

Config.Name: Custom Start Command
Config.Description: Advanced: optional single RWR console command sent instead of start_script. Leave blank for normal START_SCRIPT behavior.

Config.Name: Additional Server Arguments
Config.Description: Advanced: optional whitespace-separated arguments passed directly to the RWR server executable. Shell operators and quoted values are not supported.

Config.Name: Shutdown Timeout
Config.Description: Advanced: seconds to wait for RWR to stop through its console before sending SIGTERM. The default fits within Docker's normal stop window.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name shown for the RWR server. Applied to the managed vanilla invasion script.

Config.Name: Server Comment
Config.Description: Short description shown with the server. Applied to the managed vanilla invasion script.

Config.Name: Server Website
Config.Description: Optional website URL shown for the server. Leave blank when unused.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: Port written into the managed RWR invasion script. Keep this equal to both container port mappings.

Config.Name: Maximum Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players accepted by the RWR server.

Config.Name: Public Server
Config.Description: Set true to register the server in the public RWR server list, or false for direct-connect only.

Config.Name: Player Faction
Config.Description: Client faction for vanilla invasion: 0 greenbelts, 1 graycollars, or 2 brownpants.

Config.Name: Profile Persistence
Config.Description: RWR profile persistence mode: forever or forever_and_match.

Config.Name: Admin Usernames
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated RWR player usernames granted administrator access. Names are converted to lowercase and written to admins.xml.

Config.Name: RWR TCP Port
Config.Description: RWR server TCP port. The bundled vanilla start_invasion.as script listens on port 1240.

Config.Name: RWR UDP Port
Config.Description: RWR server UDP port. The bundled vanilla start_invasion.as script listens on port 1240.
